capabilities: : Link plugin folders to a shared store
: Automatically connect new vaults to the shared store
: Synchronize plugin installations and updates across vaults
: Export and import plugin lists for cross-machine sharing
disambiguation: Not a cloud synchronization service; it manages local plugin files via a shared store or manifest mode.
extras: Desktop only: it uses symlinks and Node.js APIs. Tested on macOS; Linux should work. Windows is untested; mobile is not supported. Plugin settings (data.json) in the shared store are also shared: some plugins may behave unexpectedly.
problem: Obsidian community plugins are isolated per vault, forcing users to manually install and update plugins in every vault.
summary: A shared plugin store that links all vaults to a single directory, ensuring plugins are installed and updated only once across all local vaults.
